modules.module_title: Conduct survey for identifying potential/new consumer

pcs.pc_description: collect list of locations/area allocated for conducting survey, from reporting authority
conduct market research and analysis to evaluate trends, brand awareness and competition ventures
prepare Feature Advantage Benefit (FAB) details of PNG connections
classify the locations/area on the basis of type of demography (domestic, industrial or commercial) for survey
coordinate with the Resident Welfare Associations / Managing Committee of the society / area for any type of permissions / assistance
survey the household population in the colonies /societies, industrial & commercial areas, allocated for new PNG registration
analyze the survey for creating the database of potential PNG consumers
develop the database of potential PNG consumers and submit the report to reporting authority
prepare the marketing plan as per the monthly/quarterly targets received from reporting authority for registration of new PNG connections
prepare presentation to address the potential PNG consumers
plan appropriate branding activities (awareness cum registration camps, TV cable ads’, audio / visual presentations, door to door marketing etc) to attract new/potential PNG consumers.
prepare and use promotional and digital marketing materials such as leaflets, posters, banners, Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ), etc. for disseminating information about PNG connections
obtain necessary consent/approval for circulating the marking/branding material for promotion of PNG business

pcs.pc_description: setup registration camp for marketing of PNG connection in the allocated area
carryout various marketing activities such as advertising, telemarketing, door-to-door marketing, mailers etc. to promote PNG connections
analyse the requirements and interests of potential consumer’s during interaction
address the queries of potential consumers generated through various marketing activities
collect reference from existing consumers to generate new connection
follow-up with the potential consumers at regular interval
maintain the records of all marketing activities, new/potential consumers and submit updates to reporting authority
update marketing plan time to time as per the response from consumers

modules.module_title: Carry out registration process and coordinate for installation of new PNG connections

pcs.pc_description: assist consumer to fill registration form

check if the filled registration form is complete and duly signed by the consumer, submitted along with the required supporting documents and registration fee/ security deposit and submit the same to the agency
follow-up with consumer in case of non clearance of registration fee/ security deposit payment or any discrepancy in registration form and supporting documents
ensure that acknowledgement slip (mentioning consumer relationship number and BP number) is handed over to the consumer, after registration process is completed
coordinate with project/installation team to facilitate the installation of PNG connection
ensure that consumer details, along with details of tariff plan are submitted to the billing department
